Biology.style: 90 single-correct 4-option MCQs covering Botany and Zoology (+4/-1 marking). Easy to moderate difficulty emphasizing precise curriculum recall, taxonomic/physiological exceptions, and sequential processes. Heavy reliance on Statement-I/II pairs, Assertion-Reason pairs, multi-statement subset options, List-I/II matching tables, fill-in-the-blank stems, and negative ('incorrect'/'not') phrasing. Calculations are sparse and elementary (ploidy, glycolysis stoichiometry, linear growth, Hardy-Weinberg, zero-growth population). No diagrams or visual figures appear in this section.

chapters.UNIT 1: DIVERSITY IN LIVING WORLD: Tests taxonomic hierarchy ordering and matching, symmetry/chamber exceptions in animal phyla, microbial/fungal/plant-group classification, and infectious agent definitions.
chapters.UNIT 2: STRUCTURAL ORGANISATION IN ANIMA: Tests frog respiration and cranial nerve counts, plant morphology definitions, placentation matching, and floral family trait subsets.
chapters.UNIT 3: CELL STRUCTURE AND FUNCTION: Tests organelle structure-function matching, prokaryotic vs endomembrane features, cell-cycle phase sequencing, biomolecule roles, and elemental weight ranking.
chapters.UNIT 4: PLANT PHYSIOLOGY: Tests arithmetic growth calculation, glycolysis/Calvin-cycle stoichiometry, photorespiration reactants and statements, pigment/experiment sequencing, and plant growth regulator roles.
chapters.UNIT 5: HUMAN PHYSIOLOGY: Tests endocrine gland/hormone matching and multi-statement checks, skeletal/vertebral ordering, cardiac pacemaker rates and valves, nephron reabsorption, neural coverings, and neuromuscular signaling.
chapters.UNIT 6: REPRODUCTION: Tests angiosperm anther/gametophyte/seed traits, endosperm ploidy calculation, gamete/placental hormones, ovarian cycle Statement pairs, and assisted reproductive methods.
chapters.UNIT 7: GENETICS AND EVOLUTION: Tests Mendelian Assertion-Reason, ABO blood-group parental exclusions, chromosomal disorder pairs, operon/transcription enzyme recall, Hardy-Weinberg frequency math, and evolution evidence/homology/human-origin items.
chapters.UNIT 8: BIOLOGY AND HUMAN WELFARE: Tests bioactive therapeutic agents, secondary lymphoid organ subsets, parasite life-cycle statements, colostrum antibodies, and analgesic drugs.
chapters.UNIT 9: BIOTECHNOLOGY AND ITS APPLICATIO: Tests Bt-toxin activation mechanism, PCR step sequencing, plasmid Statement pairs, cell-lysis enzymes, and vector feature matching.
chapters.UNIT 10: ECOLOGY AND ENVIRONMENT: Tests biodiversity species-richness ordering, species-interaction matching, trophic roles, logistic vs exponential growth Assertion-Reason, energy pyramid statements, and zero-net-growth population math.
